content:
Last month, the beta version of the WhatsApp Android app started showing a green dot for contacts who are online. The beta of the iPhone app is now doing the same.

The feature does seem to take care to protect privacy in a couple of ways, which is not always a given with Meta apps …

WAbetainfo spotted the new feature.

Meta has applied a couple of privacy protections to the feature. First, if you’ve chosen to hide your online status in the privacy section of the settings, that also applies to the new green dot. Second, you’re only shown as online while you actually have the app open.

At present, the status indicator is rather hidden. You won’t see it within an open chat or on your main chat list, but only if you tap on the bar at the top of a chat to see the contact info. The site expects it to be given greater visibility once people have had a chance to get used to it. In particular, Meta is reportedly working on a Contacts screen, which will list contacts currently online or recently active.

As is usual with WhatsApp, beta features roll out to a small number of users initially, so you may or may not see it even if you are using the latest beta.
